dreamteamer.title: Users
dreamteamer.description: The people and agents work is assigned to: one `users` collection that the owner, lead, seat and assignee fields of tasks, meetings and projects point at. A user links to their `contacts` record rather than merging with it, nothing here authenticates anyone, and every agent row names the human who owns it. Peers `contacts`, `companies` and `assets`.
